rationale: Adds pulp_stage_skia_icu_data and stages Skia's ICU data file beside the pulp-import-design executable on Windows, so the CLI no longer aborts in SkParagraph on its first text shaping. The change is a post-build file copy in the build graph. No design-import lowering, Chromium capture, rendering, or packaging authority moves, and no import output changes.
